_doc: Applied by gen-voiceover to every Russian line before TTS (whole words, case-insensitive). Author's fixes collected from frame notes; add one line per new complaint and it never comes back. Acute U+0301 never on «и» (it hardens the vowel).
patterns: «Не X. Не Y.» : a sentence-initial «Не» after a full stop is read as «НЭ»; the first one is fine
no em dashes, the author's rule; a comma keeps the breath
